name: Euler
gap: First insider unlock taken as 2022-01-01, the start of linear (stream) vesting: Euler's own docs say 'Founder vesting linear unlock schedule starting on 01/01/2022' for Euler Labs; DefiLlama shows the schedule starting 'Jan 1, 2022' as daily linear streams for Euler Labs (4,930 EUL/day), Shareholders (12,823 EUL/day), DAO Partners and Encode Incubator; Tokenradar says investor and incubator allocations have linear unlocks beginning January 2022 and dates the genesis mint 2021-12-30. Conflict: DropsTab (which carries an accuracy disclaimer) lists a TGE on 2021-11-26 with 5.55% TGE unlocks for Euler Labs Shareholders and EulerDAO partners; if correct, launch day would be the first insider unlock. The precise date insiders could first transfer EUL is therefore not settled (dateConflict-type issue; both dates are before the 2023-03-01 window). No 25%+ single-day unlock in the window: insider allocations vested as daily linear streams (DefiLlama, Tokenradar list no large single-day unlocks 2023-2025); DropsTab's 2023-04-26 / 2024-04-26 / 2025-10-26 dates appear to be vesting-end markers of linear schedules, not cliffs, and no other source shows a lump on those dates. Euler docs now state strategic-partner tokens are 'fully unlocked'. Sources: https://docs.euler.finance/EUL/overview (primary), https://defillama.com/unlocks/euler (aggregator), https://tokenradar.ai/tokens/euler/tokenomics (aggregator), https://dropstab.com/coins/euler/vesting (aggregator), https://www.binance.com/fr/research/projects/euler (Binance Research, 2025-10-26).

name: Kaia (ex-Klaytn KLAY + Finschia FNSA)
gap: KAIA is a migration token: per Kaia's transition FAQ, KLAY balances were automatically reflected as KAIA and FNSA holders burned FNSA to claim KAIA; circulating supply rose from ~3.804B to ~5.805B KAIA at the merger. Tokenradar dates the FNSA-holder conversion cliff (1,179,000,000) to 2024-08-29, before the 2024-10-01 window, so it is not listed. First insider unlock belongs to the KLAY era: Klaytn genesis 2019-06-24 (Tokenradar), mainnet live 2019-06-27 (CoinDesk); Binance Research lists Private Sale 18% and Team 5% but its release-schedule section is empty, and Tokenradar says private-sale vesting finished by March 2021 without a start date. Whether investors/team could transfer on launch day, or the first insider release date, could not be confirmed, so null. No B event: Tokenradar finds no single-day unlock in Oct 2024-Nov 2025 (only claim-based portal/reward caps and PoS issuance) and lists no team allocation for KAIA; the FAQ mentions no team/investor lockups. Sources: https://docs.kaia.io/misc/kaia-transition/faq-chain-transition/ (primary), https://tokenradar.ai/tokens/kaia/tokenomics, https://tokenradar.ai/tokens/klaytn/tokenomics (aggregators), https://www.binance.com/research/projects/klaytn (Binance Research), https://hotfix.coindesk.com/markets/2019/06/27/kakaos-klaytn-blockchain-has-gone-live-with-support-from-major-firms (news).

name: Mantle (ex-BitDAO BIT)
gap: Input shows no Binance perp (binancePerpSince null), so binanceFuturesSymbol is null. MNT is a migration token (BIT -> MNT 1:1 per Mantle's AMA recap; Tokenradar dates the MNT creation to 2023-06-20 and says the schedule 'was fully unlocked on July 7, 2023'), all before the 2023-10-01 window. First insider unlock is in the BitDAO era. ICO Drops gives the TGE as 2021-08-16 (IDO on Sushi MISO, no lock-up). Token Terminal (from BitDAO docs/forum) shows 'ByBit Flexible' 1.5B BIT and Launch Partner Rewards 'Fully unlocked on the 15th of July 2021', i.e. before or at TGE. Bybit was BitDAO's founding backer/contributor, so the launch day is treated as the first insider unlock (atLaunch true). If Bybit is not counted as an insider, the first VC unlock is the private-sale lock-up end, 2021-10-15, after which the 500M private-sale BIT vested monthly to 2022-10-15 (Token Terminal; ICO Drops: '3 months cliff, then linear over 12 months'). No B event in the window: Bybit Locked (4.5B) vested monthly 2022-07-15 to 2024-07-15 (~187.5M/month, a few % of supply), the Mantle AMA says Bybit's tokens were 'immediately vested and transferred to the Mantle Treasury', and Tokenradar lists no further scheduled releases or single-day unlocks Oct 2023-Nov 2025 (the treasury is released by governance, not a schedule). Sources: https://bb-add-morpho-tvl.preview.tokenterminal.com/terminal/projects/bitdao/vesting-schedule (aggregator, from BitDAO docs), https://icodrops.com/bitdao (aggregator), https://medium.com/0xmantle/the-new-mantle-token-ama-recap-de6715dc6103 (primary), https://tokenradar.ai/tokens/mantle/tokenomics (aggregator).

name: Sky (ex-MakerDAO MKR)
gap: SKY is a migration token: MKR converts at 1 MKR = 24,000 SKY (The Block, 2025-09-19), the upgrade window for exchanges ran to 2025-09-18 (imToken notice), and a 1% Delayed Upgrade Penalty was voted on from 2025-09-22, rising 1 point every three months. About 81% of MKR had been upgraded by then, with ~176,070 MKR left. Conversions add SKY supply gradually and are not insider unlocks. There is no team/investor vesting schedule for SKY on any fetched page; insider ownership dates back to the MKR era (Maker Foundation, pre-2021), and the first insider unlock date could not be confirmed, so null. No 25%+ single-day unlock to insiders in the 2025-08-01 to 2025-11-16 window was found. The only supply-raising mechanism in the window is the MKR->SKY upgrade (a migration, flag 'migration'), and The Block reports no team/investor emission. Searches spent: 1 (kept low because the token has no vesting structure). Sources: https://www.theblock.co/news/ecosystems/2025-09-19-sky-opens-vote-to-penalize-stragglers-delaying-mkr-to-sky-token-conversion-371401 (news), https://support.token.im/hc/en-us/articles/47889144241177-MKR-SKY-Token-Upgrade-Swap-Your-MKR-for-SKY-by-September-18-2025 (wallet notice, not fetched; title only).

name: Codatta
gap: TGE confirmed as 2025-07-23 (Codatta's own docs history page; BingX also says the token 'officially launched on July 23, 2025'). Supply 10,000,000,000 XNY (Binance announcement 2025-06-23). Allocation per Codatta docs: Team 18%, Investors 12.5%, Advisor Incentives 3.5%, plus ecosystem/airdrop pools. The docs say only that unlocks 'follow the published schedule (cliffs + linear vests per pool)', and CoinEx says investors are 'with cliffs' and the team is 'vested over time'. None of Codatta docs, Kraken's crypto-asset statement (2025-07-10), Binance, CoinEx, BingX, DefiLlama or CMC give TGE percentages or cliff lengths. So whether insiders received anything at TGE, and the date of the first insider unlock, are unconfirmed (null). Circulating figures conflict: BingX/CoinEx cite ~8.2B (Aug 2025, CoinGecko), while DefiLlama and BingX market data show ~3.636B now. That gap makes the circulating-supply history unreliable. No 25%+ single-day insider unlock between 2025-07-23 and 2025-11-16 was found in any source. With cliffs on investor allocations, a first insider cliff within four months of TGE is unlikely, but this is not confirmed. Sources: https://codatta.mintlify.app/en/community/history and https://codatta.mintlify.app/en/protocol-token/tokenomics (primary), https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/901d960af2134457aa1e9d72ce6e30fd (exchange), https://assets-cms.kraken.com/files/51n36hrp/facade/e92068a3ca09c938899007f60c5dcc1dfc2c218b.pdf (exchange statement), https://bingx.com/en/price/codatta, https://defillama.com/token/XNY (aggregators).
